name: @tejoma/candidate-core-service
description: Tejoma Candidate Core Service - Tier 0. Owns a dual-written mirror of the monolith's `candidates` table (the recruiter-facing, resume-parsed profile - distinct from candidate-service's candidate_accounts self-service login/profile). As of the remaining-monolith migration Step 3a, GET /api/candidates* is gateway-routed and served directly from this service's own already-fresh mirror; writes (create/delete/bulk-upload/import) proxy to the monolith, which remains the sole writer (candidate.routes.ts's createCandidateWithSideEffects/deleteCandidate, unchanged) so every other still-monolith surface reading `candidates` directly keeps working.
